כיום ניתן למצוא מגוון קסדות VR בשוק, חלק: Today there is a wide range of VR headsets on the market, some older models and some more modern. Of them all, the Quest 3 stands out as the best value for money for architectural use.
הבחירה המובילה לשימוש אדריכלי. מציעה איז: The leading choice for architectural use. A perfect balance of price, display quality and performance. Supports Mixed Reality and allows high-quality virtual reality experiences.
אלטרנטיבה מעניינת ל-Quest 3, עם מפרט דומ: An interesting alternative to the Quest 3, with similar specs and a competitive price. Less common in Israel but good value.
הקסדה הפרימיום ביותר בשוק. מציעה טכנולוג: The most premium headset on the market. The most advanced technology, but at a much higher price. Suits offices with a large budget looking for the best experience.
מיועדת בעיקר לגיימינג על קונסולת PlaySta: Made mainly for gaming on the PlayStation 5 console. Less suited to professional use, but an excellent gaming experience.
קסדה למקצוענים עם מערכת מעקב מתקדמת ביות: A headset for professionals with the most advanced tracking system. Needs a strong computer and a fairly complex setup, but gives excellent accuracy and experience.
קסדה עסקית המיועדת לארגונים. מציעה תמיכה: A business headset made for organizations. Professional technical support and management tools for several headsets. A relatively high price.
קסדה עם רזולוציה גבוהה במיוחד, מתאימה למ: A headset with especially high resolution, for anyone looking for the highest image quality. Needs a very strong computer.
